body.statement: Under the variance-aware static comparator, \[\lim_{T\to\infty}-T^{-1}\log\mathbb P_{\mu,s}^{\mathrm{stat}}(\widehat h_T^{\mathrm{stat}}\ne h)=I_w(\mu)=\min_{j\ne h}\frac{\Delta_j^2}{2(v_h+v_j)}.\]
body.justification: This pins the exact variance-aware benchmark rather than an assumed stand-in.
body.gap: Kato's GNA-EBA theorem uses this pairwise Gaussian benchmark in the equal-gap maximin regime; the lemma records its full instancewise value for the selected \(w\).
body.consumer: The static exponent is the denominator used by experiment designers to report the adaptive gain for each fundraising-treatment mean vector.
